subject: Nimbus Analytics — MSA + Order Form intake (initial redlines & action playlist)
messages:
From: Liam O'Connor <liam@nim-analytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: procure@nim-analytics.com, Sophie Reed <sophie@nim-analytics.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Dec 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: MSA + Order Form kickoff (Nimbus)

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the demo last week — we had good internal signal and leadership want to move forward. Attaching the draft MSA and proposed order form we normally use. High level asks from our side:
- Confirm Redwood's residency and subprocessing for EU customers (we have EU end customers).
- Can you provide a runbook for on-call escalation SLA exceptions?
- We expect a 12-month committed order for 200k tokens/month to start; will need billing contact and PO flow.

Would like to kick off intake + initial redlines this week if possible. Who should I expect to coordinate with on your side for legal redlines and exhibit mapping?

Attachments: Nimbus_MSA_v1_redline.docx (Word, draft redlines), OrderForm_NIM-20251215.xlsx (Excel)

Best,
Liam
Procurement | Nimbus Analytics
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam@nim-analytics.com>
Cc: procure@nim-analytics.com, Sophie Reed <sophie@nim-analytics.com>, kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Dec 2025 10:31:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form kickoff (Nimbus)

Hi Liam — great to hear and thanks for sending the drafts. Looping in Kimberly (contracts lead) and Jonas (legal) who will own redlines and SLA/residency questions.

Below is an intake "action playlist" to keep us aligned and reduce back-and-forth. Proposed owner and target dates included — let me know if the timeline needs to be accelerated.

1) Intake & party sheet (owner: Marissa) — today
   - Confirm counterparty legal name, billing address, tax ID, and PO contact.
2) Security & residency checklist (owner: Jonas) — 48 hours
   - SOC 2 attestation and region residency for EU customers; Jonas will pull our standard addendum.
3) Commercial redline pass (owner: Kimberly) — 72 hours
   - Kimberly to mark up MSA for standard Redwood positions (indemnity, liability cap, data use).
4) Order form confirmation (owner: Marissa + Naomi) — 72 hours
   - Confirm seat count, commitment, billing cadence, and pricing table in attached XLSX.
5) Exec approval & sign route (owner: Marissa) — 7 business days (target)

Immediate asks for you (Liam/Sophie):
- Confirm legal entity exact name and billing contact (name/email).
- Confirm whether Nimbus requires a data processing addendum (DPA) or country-specific addenda beyond EU residency.
- If Finance will issue a PO, please share the PO template or expected field values.

I attached a short intake checklist (Drive link below) that helps us capture everything in one pass. We will produce a first redline bundle and a clean order form for signature.

Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/drive/folders/nimbus-contracts-4872

Marissa Cole
Account Executive — Enterprise
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: intake-checklist.pdf (stub)]
From: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam@nim-analytics.com>, Sophie Reed <sophie@nim-analytics.com>, procure@nim-analytics.com
Date: Mon, 15 Dec 2025 14:00:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form kickoff (Nimbus)

Thanks Marissa / Liam — quick scan notes and timing.

Liam: I will do the commercial redline pass today and provide annotated MSA with our standard positions. A couple of heads-up items that will affect negotiation time:
- Liability cap: Our standard is aggregate fees x 12 (we can propose). If Nimbus asks for unlimited liability for specific carveouts please flag now.
- Data residency: we have an EU residency addendum; Jonas, can you confirm whether the standard addendum covers subprocessor lists and Schrems II considerations?
- Export controls / restricted use: confirm whether Nimbus will need additional language for regulated customers; this can add a day.

Next steps (my timeline):
- By EOD today: annotated MSA (tracked changes) + comment summary
- By EOD tomorrow: clean order form draft reflecting 200k token commitment and billing cadence (weekly vs monthly?)

Action for Nimbus: please provide the exact legal entity and a billing PO contact (email + phone). Also attach any vendor compliance form your procurement requires — we often upload evidence instead of completing lengthy forms.

[Attachment: Nimbus_MSA_v1_KP_redline.docx (Word, annotations)]

Kimberly Park
Contracts Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Sophie Reed <sophie@nim-analytics.com>
To: kimberly_park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Liam O'Connor <liam@nim-analytics.com>, procure@nim-analytics.com
Date: Tue, 16 Dec 2025 15:04:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form kickoff (Nimbus)

Hi Kimberly / Marissa — thanks for the quick turnaround and the checklist.

Couple of clarifications from Nimbus:
- Legal entity: Nimbus Analytics, Inc. (EIN: 12-3456789). Billing contact: Priya Desai <priya@nim-analytics.com>, +1 (415) 555-0192.
- Procurement: we will issue a PO after contract is agreed; typical PO fields: vendor name, vendor address, Redwood Inference, NV123 Redwood St., San Francisco, CA, 94107, payment terms 30 days net.
- Residency: we do require the EU residency addendum; we have no extra country-specific terms.
- Compliance: attaching signed SOC 2 attestation and a short vendor questionnaire — hope this helps speed validation.

We reviewed Kimberly's initial notes and are OK with Redwood's standard liability cap proposal (fees x 12) as long as service availability targets are captured in the SLA exhibit. Happy to have Jonas confirm technical residency language.

Attachments: Nimbus_SOC2_Attestation_2024.pdf, Vendor_Questionnaire_Nimbus.pdf

Next: we approved the proposed timeline — please send the tracked MSA back when ready and we'll aim to turn around comments within 48 hours. If everything is agreed we can route via DocuSign; I'll watch for the link.

Thanks,
Sophie Reed
Head of Procurement | Nimbus Analytics
